reading: The sketch lays out a Spotify-like page: a left "Your Library" list, a main column with a gradient header and a track table, and a bottom now-playing bar. A run-scoped note sets the whole-page style (near-black background, Helvetica, white text), and per-block typed notes give exact content and, for the bottom bar, precise sizes/positions for each of its 9 sub-elements.
